title: MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation
title_zh: MiMaAlign：面向物理合理性视频生成的分层微观-宏观对齐方法

paragraphs.en: MiMaAlign 提出了一种分层微观-宏观对齐方法，以提高视频生成的物理合理性。 Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: MiMaAlign 提出了一种分层微观-宏观对齐方法，以提升视频生成的物理合理性。文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型在生成高保真视觉内容方面取得了显著进展，但其输出仍常出现物理上不合理的现象，包括动态不连续和事件互动不合理等。 现有的表示对齐方法主要传递通用视频特征或短程运动线索，将物理合理性视为一个单层次表示问题。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 MiMaAlign——一种分层微观-宏观对齐框架，它将互补的动力学导向知识和事件导向知识注入预训练视频扩散模型的不同抽象层级中。 具体而言，微观层级的连续动态对齐通过将扩散特征与神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）所学习的连续时间运动表示进行对齐来施加约束；而宏观层级的常识性事件对齐则通过指令提示的视觉-语言模型（VLM），提供物体互动和事件语义的表示。 我们仅通过训练辅助目标，将来自两个教师模型互补的监督信号分别与生成器中较浅和较深的特征进行对齐，从而帮助生成器内化相应的物理先验知识。 实证评估表明，在 CogVideoX-2B 上，MiMaAlign 在 VideoPhy 基准测试的物理常识（PC）得分相比基线模型最高提升了 21.0%，并在极具挑战性的 VideoPhy2 基准测试中取得了显著进步；同时，它在 VBench 上保持了整体视频质量，并得到了盲测用户对比的支持。
